question: Alivardi Khan was followed by __________ as the Nawab of Bengal.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sirajuddaulah.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alivardi Khan** was the **Nawab of Bengal** from **1740 to 1756.**
 
• After his death, his grandson **Sirajuddaulah** succeeded him as the **Nawab of Bengal.**
